events.title: Jackson Town Square
events.blurb: The square with its four elk-antler arches, strung with lights for the holidays.
events.blurbEs: La plaza con sus cuatro arcos de astas de alce, iluminados para las fiestas.

events.title: National Museum of Wildlife Art
events.blurb: Wildlife art from Bierstadt to Warhol, overlooking the Elk Refuge.
events.blurbEs: Arte de vida salvaje de Bierstadt a Warhol, con vistas al refugio de alces.

events.title: Grand Teton National Park
events.blurb: Winter views of the Tetons; the inner park road closes to cars for the season.
events.blurbEs: Vistas invernales de los Teton; la carretera interior se cierra a los coches en temporada.
